items.title: You own everything

faqs.question: Which couriers do you integrate?
faqs.answer: Local GCC couriers and global carriers (Aramex, DHL, etc.) plus aggregators — chosen for your regions and volumes.

faqs.question: Does it update customers automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes — customers get automated tracking and status updates, which cuts "where is my order" support tickets.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
